description: Architecture style: Clean Architecture + MVVM + Repository pattern
Reverse engineering method: capture + APK analysis, no binary reverse engineering of protocol internals by the AI
No dependency on Google Play Services or any network permission
Device discovery via CompanionDeviceManager, no continuous BLE scanning
Bounded exception to the no-BLE-scanning rule, for the Fast Pair Battery Notification only
`CAPTURE_BLUETOOTH_HCI_SNOOP.md` Groups are capture scenarios, not tests; `TESTPLAN_BLUETOOTH_HCI_SNOOP.md` is the test/behavior catalog
Fast Pair Account Linking, Ownership Transfer, and the Accessory Non-Owner Service are out of scope
ANC command channel confirmed as Fast Pair Message Stream (DLCI 0x04); `FrameEncoder` implementation blocked pending `CAP-006`
PROJECT_RULES.md rule 19 does not apply to the maintainer's own captures under captures/
